install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-e1ec4515171760d29cef，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-github-picker 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e1ec4515171760d29cef.html
posts.en:
dsh-github-picker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e1ec4515171760d29cef.html
